name: zinterp_context_is_macro_true
description: zInterp_Context::IsMacroTrue checks whether a named macro exists and has the exact value TRUE.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja flags the inlined strcmp tail at 0x4c175e because the sbb-based compare result is not lifted cleanly; assembly review confirms it is a strcmp-style equality check against TRUE.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c1710 validates the FindMacroValue(name, NULL) dependency, null/missing return of 0, and exact case-sensitive comparison with the literal TRUE.
The native smoke verifies TRUE, FALSE, lowercase true, and missing macro behavior.
